evidence: Alters core block validation script verification in ConnectBlock and modifies CheckInputScripts in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: This PR unifies single- and multithreaded script checking paths in ConnectBlock and resolves an omission where TestBlockValidity omitted script cache population in multithreaded mode. Eliminating the dual semantics of CheckInputScripts removes a long-standing point of confusion in validation code and prepares for future batch validation work, but the change is primarily structural and deferrable.
